candidates.source_name: DOZORRO — громадський контроль публічних закупівель (TI Ukraine)

Aggregates per-tender feedback, community monitoring, official complaints and links straight back to Prozorro tender IDs (e.g. UA-2020-02-24-002415-c pattern). Primary jump-off point for identifying problem buyers of banking/payments IT (NBU, Oschadbank, PrivatBank, Ukrposhta) and the civic monitors who track them.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-based crawl (headless with realistic UA) of /blog and /tender/<prozorro-id> pages; cross-key on Prozorro tender IDs. Plain HTTP fetch returned 403.

brief: Ukraine's procurement-watchdog layer is unusually mature and tightly interlinked: Transparency International Ukraine sits at the centre, operating DOZORRO (portal, community of monitoring NGOs, blog) and having built the BI Prozorro public and professional analytics modules, with Infobox Prozorro supplying the methodology explanations and Clarity Project/YouControl providing the register cross-joins that identify who actually wins. A second ring — StateWatch (co-author of new Prozorro contract-amendment risk indicators), KSE's Centre of Excellence in Procurement, AntAC/ACREC, and investigative outlets Наші гроші and Bihus.Info — supplies the narrative and named-actor commentary, while RISE Ukraine/DREAM and Open Contracting Partnership set the transparency norms for reconstruction-linked contracting and the Government Transparency Institute supplies the single-bidding red-flag methodology. Two practical constraints dominate: the two most central domains (dozorro.org, ti-ukraine.org) returned 403 to plain HTTP fetches and will need headless-browser collection, and nothing in this cell is scoped to banking or payments — sector signal must be produced by applying a Ukrainian-language keyword/CPV filter to these generic watchdog datasets and feeds rather than by reading curated sector pages.
